_about: The telecom page's square network (Round 86, batch 12): references/telecom-nidd-square-student-preregistration.md, run as pre-registered (docs/measurements/telecom-nidd-square-student-2026-11-28.json), and on the owner's choice of 2026-11-28 in place of the linear student on the page's encrypted 5G-NIDD path. Written by scripts/export_telecom_square_network.py.

decision.rule: the first class with the largest logit

batch_norm: none: the re-run's recipe has none, so nothing is folded
default_set_note: B, the owner's choice of 2026-11-28: under A2 the largest logit error varies from run to run and passed the page's 1e-3 rule in two of 27 runs, under B it stayed near 2e-5 (references/telecom-nidd-square-student-preregistration-addendum-spread.md)
corpus: 5G-NIDD (real traffic from a 5G test network, University of Oulu)
split: P2's test part: in each (capture file, class) group in file order, the last 15 percent (references/telecom-nidd-clean-protocols-preregistration.md)
fitNote: fitted on P2's training part, the epoch kept by validation macro-F1
attribution: Y. Siriwardhana et al., 'Descriptor: 5G Wireless Network Intrusion Detection Dataset (5G-NIDD)', in IEEE Data Descriptions, doi:10.1109/IEEEDATA.2025.3592888. Dataset: doi:10.23729/e80ac9df-d9fb-47e7-8d0d-01384a415361, CC BY 4.0.
modifications: The flows published twice under contradictory labels lose their Benign copy; the 30 numeric inputs without LEAF's six columns (the re-run's F30); 2,048 flows of P2's test part, each class in its share (numpy.random.default_rng(0)), raw, for the page to standardise by the training part's moments and clip at 20, as the network's client does.
